pages.title: Where to find
pages.text: Look for the encounter at: Ruined Citadel.

pages.title: How to fight
pages.text: Find the Ender Golem in the Ruined Citadel. Its ground slam affects an area: do not stay close at impact. Leave the zone, then retaliate. The Void Core obtained afterward has its own use; defeating this golem is not the same as defeating the Ender Guardian.

pages.title: What does not work
pages.text: Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.

pages.title: Drops
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Void Core. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.
